malevelon-creek.title: Malevelon Creek
malevelon-creek.description: Malevelon Creek is an ionic jungle world in the Severin Sector that became one of the most famous battlefields of the Second Galactic War. Early in the war, Helldivers repeatedly fought Automaton forces there despite difficult conditions and limited support.

meridia.title: Meridia
meridia.description: Meridia became a Terminid Supercolony after some Terminids adapted to the Termicide used by Super Earth. The planet was eventually destroyed using Dark Fluid, collapsing it into the Meridian Black Hole.

cyberstan.title: Cyberstan
cyberstan.description: Cyberstan is the historic homeworld of the Cyborgs and a major location in the conflict surrounding the Automatons and Super Earth.

oshaune.title: Oshaune
oshaune.description: Oshaune is a planet in the Mirin Sector and the first Terminid Hive World discovered by Super Earth. After being hidden within the Gloom for more than a year, the planet underwent extreme Terminid terraformation, developing vast subterranean cave networks and Spore Lungs responsible for producing Gloom spores. Helldiver expeditions discovered dangerous new and returning Terminid threats on Oshaune, including the Rupture Strain, Dragonroaches, and Hive Lords. In November 2185, Oshaune was liberated and 99% of its Spore Lungs were destroyed, causing the Gloom to dramatically recede.

seasse.title: Seasse (Void Source Planet)
seasse.description: Seasse was the first planet consumed by the Void after Appropriator forces activated ancient Illuminate Exospires on its surface. Months later, Super Earth identified Seasse as the world located at the center and source of the anomaly. During Operation Void Piercer, Helldivers and SEAF forces invaded the planet while a Ministry of Science expedition descended into its depths. Seasse was liberated on August 23, 2186, and the successful destruction of the Void's source caused the anomaly to dissipate across the galaxy.

afoyay-bay.title: Afoyay Bay
afoyay-bay.description: Afoyay Bay is a human-controlled world in the Gallux Sector that became an important strategic and political center during the later Second Galactic War. The planet is home to the Center for the Confinement of Dissidence and Pandora Base. It was liberated to allow construction of the massive CECOD detention complex and later became the primary development site for Operation Free Space and the Star of Peace.

new-york-supreme.title: New York Supreme
new-york-supreme.description: New York Supreme is the name selected for the reconstruction of York Supreme, the former Sector 7 Mega City on Super Earth. York Supreme was catastrophically destroyed during the Illuminate invasion of Super Earth in 2185. Citizens later voted on a replacement name, with New York Supreme winning the Managed Democratic poll. Reconstruction resources intended for the city were subsequently diverted to Afoyay Bay to accelerate construction of the Center for the Confinement of Dissidence.

prosperity-city.title: Prosperity City
prosperity-city.description: Prosperity City is the Mega City capital of Super Earth's Sector 3, corresponding broadly to the region once known as Northern Europe. During the Illuminate invasion of Super Earth in 2185, most of the planet's Mega Cities were devastated or destroyed. Prosperity City and Equality-on-Sea were the only two reported to remain standing after the Illuminate were repelled, making Prosperity City one of the surviving major urban centers of Super Earth.

equality-on-sea.title: Equality-on-Sea
equality-on-sea.description: Equality-on-Sea is the Mega City capital of Super Earth's Sector 2, covering much of the region once known as mainland China. The city takes its name from the historic conference at which Humanity was declared the most Equal species in the galaxy. During the 2185 Battle for Super Earth, Equality-on-Sea endured repeated Illuminate attacks but never fell. Alongside Prosperity City, it was one of only two Mega Cities still standing when the Great Host was driven from Super Earth.

port-mercy.title: Port Mercy
port-mercy.description: Port Mercy was the Mega City capital of Super Earth's Sector 1, corresponding broadly to Oceania, Southeast Asia, and Japan. The city became famous after sheltering millions of loyal refugees during the Last Great War and was described as a safe haven for Class-A citizens in need. During the 2185 Illuminate invasion of Super Earth, Port Mercy came under siege and was ultimately destroyed by the Great Host.

administrative-center-02.title: Administrative Center 02
administrative-center-02.description: Administrative Center 02 was the Mega City capital of Super Earth's Sector 4, spanning Southern Europe and Western Africa. Known commonly as AdminCen, the city was celebrated for its vast bureaucratic institutions, where official forms and applications were marked with the revered Stamp of Ages. Administrative Center 02 was assaulted and destroyed by Illuminate forces during the 2185 Battle for Super Earth.

eagleopolis.title: Eagleopolis
eagleopolis.description: Eagleopolis was the Mega City capital of Super Earth's Sector 5, covering India, the Middle East, and Eastern Africa. Known as a great center of commerce, the city was renowned throughout the galaxy for its enormous shopping malls and entertainment centers. Eagleopolis was the first Mega City to fall during the 2185 Illuminate invasion of Super Earth and was ultimately destroyed by the Great Host.

gun.title: Gun
gun.description: Gun is the reconstruction name selected for Remembrance, the former Mega City capital of Super Earth's Sector 6 in Central and South America. Remembrance was destroyed by the Illuminate during the 2185 Battle for Super Earth. During a later official community vote to choose the city's new name, Gun won decisively with more than 85,000 votes and approximately 72.5 percent of the total, becoming the name chosen for the rebuilt Sector 6 capital.

remembrance.title: Remembrance
remembrance.description: Remembrance was the Mega City capital of Super Earth's Sector 6, covering Central and South America. The city was destroyed by the Illuminate during the 2185 Battle for Super Earth. It was later selected by the Ministry of Prosperity as the first destroyed Mega City to be rebuilt. Following a Managed Democratic naming vote, its reconstructed successor was officially named Gun.

york-supreme.title: York Supreme
york-supreme.description: York Supreme was the Mega City capital of Super Earth's Sector 7, covering Northern America. During the final stages of the 2185 Battle for Super Earth, the city was attacked and destroyed by the Illuminate Great Host. Reconstruction was later planned and a Managed Democratic naming vote selected New York Supreme as the city's successor name. Resources gathered for its reconstruction were subsequently redirected to construction of the Center for the Confinement of Dissidence.
